content: Dawiti Xoonida Xoonota
Hessafe guye Dawiti Filisxeeme asaa xoonides; ba shene garsan ayssides; Metegi-Aama geetettiza katamayo Filisxeemeta kusheppe woththi ekkides.

Hessaththoka Dawiti Mo7aabeta xoonides; istta biitta bolla ishisidi wodoron wadhdhi xeellides; wadhdhi xeellidaytappe nam7u kushe gidizayta izi wodhiin issi kushe gidizayti paxa attida; hessa gishshas Mo7aabe asay Dawites haarettidessinne izas giirides.
Hessafekka hara Dawiti Efiraaxise shaafa matan diza dereza zaari oykkana biidi, Xoobba kawo Erahoobe naa Hadaadi7eezere oli xoonides.
Dawiti izappe 1,000 para-gaareta, 7,000 toganchchata,
20,000 olanchchata di7ides; 100 para-gaareta xalla ashshidi hankkoyta ubbaa gildayi yeddides.
Damasqo Aaraamen diza Xoobba kawo Hadaadi7eezere maaddanaas yida wode Dawiti isttafe 22,000 as wodhides.
Hessafe guye Damasqon diza Aaraamen ba ola asata kambe giigsides. Aaraame asay izas haarettidessinne giirides; GODAY Dawiti bidaso ubbaan izas xoono immides.
Hadaadi7eezere shuumeti oykkida worqqa gondalleta Dawiti ekkidi Yerusalaame efides.
Kawo Dawiti Bexahenne Berotaye geetettiza Hadaadi7eezere katamatappe keehippe daro xarqimala denththi efides.
Hamaate dere kawo Too7uyi Dawiti kumeththa Hadaadi7eezere ola asaa xoonidayssa siyida wode,

Too7uyi Hadaadi7eezerera ubba wode olettishe diza gishshas sarokanne izi Hadaadi7eezere xoonida xoono qonccisanaas ba naa Iyoraame kawo Dawitekko kiitti yeddides; izikka birappe, worqqafenne xarqimalappe oosettida miishshata ekki yides.
Kawo Dawiti kase ba giirissida kawotappe gelida biraninne worqqan ooththida mala hayta ha miishshatakka GODAAS dummasides.
Izas giirida kawoti, Eedoome, Mo7aabe, Amoone asaa, Filisxeeme asaanne Amaaleeqe asaa. Hessaththoka Xoobba kawo Erahoobe naa Hadaadi7eezereppe di7i ekkidayssa GODAAS dummasides.
Maxine shoobba geetettizason Dawiti Eedoome asaappe 18,000 as wodhi simmidaappe guye iza sunththay keehi nashettides.
Kumeththa Eedoomen olanchchata kambe giigsides; Eedoome asay ubbay Dawites haarettides; Dawiti bidaso ubbaan GODAY izas xoono immides.
Dawite Shuumeta
Dawiti kumeththa Isra7eele bolla kawotides; deraas suure pirdanne woga essides.
Xuriya naa Iyo7aabey olanchchata halaqa; Ahiluude naa Iyoosaafixey taarike xaafe.
Qasse Ahixuube naa Saadooqeynne Abiyaataare naa Ahimelekey qeese; Sarayay xaafe.
Yoodahe naa Bannayay Kelite asasinne Pelite asas halaqa; Dawite attuma nayti kawoteththa keeththan zore immizayta.

footnotes.text: 1,000 para-gaareta, 7,000 toganchchata gizayssa issi issi Geeshsha maxaafatan 17,000 toganchchata gees.
Zore immizayta gizayssa issi issi kase wode birsheththati qeeseta geettes.
